collection.title: VW ID ID.4 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW ID.4 2020 Onwards model requires a 28" blade for the driver side and an 18" blade for the passenger side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this ID.4, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
